name: dubai-car-index
description: Dubai car prices from Dubai Car Index: UAE new-car list prices by trim, used values by year and mileage, a fair-price check for any asking price, rental rates and repair costs. Every list price carries its source and the date it was checked; every modelled figure says it is one.

interface.longDescription:
Ask what a car in Dubai should cost, to buy new or used, to rent or to repair, using Dubai Car Index. Buyers, renters and owners use it to check a price before they talk to a dealer, a seller, a rental desk or a garage.

Look up UAE list prices for 500+ models across 40+ brands, trim by trim. Get a modelled used value for any model year and mileage, and check whether an asking price is below, within or above the fair range. Compare daily, weekly and monthly rental rates, and dealer versus independent garage prices for common services. Compare cars side by side on price, value loss, rent and servicing.

Every list price carries its source and the date it was checked. Used values, rental rates and repair bands are models built from those prices and published quotes; the methodology says how, and every answer says which kind of figure it is.

UAE only, Dubai prices. Figures are guides, not offers: confirm with the dealer, seller, rental company or garage before you pay. The plugin does not buy, sell, book or pay for anything, and it does not value a specific car's condition or history. A Dubai Car Index account is required to connect.
capabilities: UAE new-car list prices by trim
Used values by model year and mileage
Fair-price check for an asking price
Daily, weekly and monthly rental rates
defaultPrompt: Is AED 165,000 a fair price for a 2021 Toyota Land Cruiser with 80,000 km?
What does a Nissan Patrol cost new in Dubai, trim by trim?
How much is a monthly rental of a Kia Sportage in Dubai?
